column2: Side view. A person lying on their back on a flat bench, feet flat on the floor, pressing a barbell with weight plates straight up above the chest with both arms extended, both hands gripping the bar.

Side view. A person lying on their back on a flat bench, feet flat on the floor, holding one dumbbell in each hand pressed straight up above the chest with extended arms; the two dumbbells are clearly separate.
Side view. A person sitting upright in a seated chest press machine, back against the pad, pushing the two handles forward at chest height with arms almost extended.
Side view. A person in the low position of a push-up: hands on the floor under the shoulders, elbows bent, chest just above the floor, body in one straight line from head to heels, toes on the floor.

Top-down view from directly above. A person lying on their back along a flat bench, head at the top of the image and legs at the bottom with both feet on the floor beside the bench, both arms opened wide to the left and right with slightly bent elbows, one dumbbell in each hand at chest height.

Front view. A person standing between the two tall towers of a cable crossover machine, one foot slightly forward, pulling one handle in each hand from the high pulleys down and together in front of the lower chest, arms slightly bent, one cable running from each hand up to its pulley.
Front view. A person sitting upright in a pec deck butterfly machine, back against the pad, both arms brought together in front of the chest holding the two vertical handles.

Side view. A person standing in a staggered stance facing away from a door, an elastic resistance band anchored behind them at chest height, both arms nearly straight brought together in front of the chest, one end of the band in each hand.

View from behind. A person hanging from a straight horizontal pull-up bar with both hands in a wide overhand grip, pulled up with bent elbows so that the chin is clearly above the bar, legs hanging straight down.

Side view. A person seated at a lat pulldown machine, thighs under a flat padded roller, pulling a wide straight bar down in front of the face to the upper chest with both hands, one cable running straight up from the middle of the bar to the pulley at the top of the machine.

Side view. A person kneeling upright on the floor, an elastic resistance band anchored high above at the top of a door, pulling one end of the band in each hand down to the shoulders with elbows pointing down.

Side view. A person standing bent forward at the hips with a flat back at about 45 degrees and slightly bent knees, pulling a barbell with weight plates up to the belly with both hands, elbows pointing back.

Side view. A person with one hand and the same-side knee resting on a flat bench, back flat and horizontal, the other foot on the floor, pulling one dumbbell up to the hip with the free hand, elbow pointing up.

Side view. A person sitting upright on the low bench of a seated cable row machine, feet braced against the foot plate, knees slightly bent, pulling a handle to the belly with both hands, one horizontal cable running from the handle to the low pulley.
Side view. A person sitting in a seated row machine with the chest against a chest pad, pulling the two handles back toward the body with bent elbows.
Side view. A person lying face up under a sturdy table, gripping the table edge with both hands and pulling the chest up to the edge, body straight, heels on the floor.

Side view. A person leaning back with a straight body, heels on the floor, holding the two handles of suspension trainer straps that are anchored high above, pulling the chest up toward the hands with bent elbows.

Side view. A person sitting upright on the floor with legs almost straight, an elastic resistance band looped around the soles of the feet, pulling one end in each hand to the belly with elbows pointing back.
Front view. A person standing upright holding a barbell with weight plates with straight arms in front of the thighs, shoulders shrugged up high toward the ears.
Front view. A person standing upright holding one dumbbell in each hand at the sides with straight arms, shoulders shrugged up high toward the ears.

Side view. A person on a 45 degree back extension bench, hips resting on the pad, ankles hooked under the foot rollers, arms crossed over the chest, body raised into one straight line from head to heels.
Side view. A person lying face down on the floor with arms stretched out forward and legs straight, with arms, chest and legs all lifted slightly off the floor at the same time.
Side view. A person standing upright pressing a barbell with weight plates straight overhead with both arms fully extended, both hands gripping the bar, legs straight.
Front view. A person sitting on a bench with an upright backrest, pressing one dumbbell in each hand overhead with arms almost extended.
Side view. A person sitting upright in a shoulder press machine, back against the pad, pushing the two handles straight up overhead with arms almost extended.
Side view. A person in a pike push-up: hands and toes on the floor, hips pushed high so the body forms an upside-down V, elbows bent and the head lowered toward the floor between the hands.
Front view. A person standing with both feet on an elastic resistance band, pressing one end of the band in each hand straight overhead with arms almost extended.
Front view. A person standing upright with both arms raised out to the sides at shoulder height, elbows slightly bent, one dumbbell in each hand.
Front view. A person standing with both feet on an elastic resistance band, both arms raised out to the sides at shoulder height, one end of the band in each hand.
Side view. A person sitting in a reverse pec deck machine facing the chest pad, both arms pulled back out to the sides at shoulder height holding the handles.
Front view. A person bent far forward at the hips with a flat back, knees slightly bent, both arms raised out to the sides at shoulder height, one dumbbell in each hand.

Side view. A person standing upright facing a cable machine, pulling a rope attachment toward the face with both hands, elbows high and pointing out, one cable running horizontally from the rope to a pulley at face height.
Front view. A person standing upright with both arms straight and spread wide to the sides at chest height, pulling an elastic resistance band apart so that it stretches across the chest.
Side view. A person standing upright, elbows close to the body, curling a barbell with weight plates up to shoulder height with both hands in an underhand grip.
Side view. A person standing upright, elbows close to the body, curling one dumbbell in each hand up to shoulder height, palms facing the shoulders.
Side view. A person standing with both feet on an elastic resistance band, elbows close to the body, curling one end of the band in each hand up to shoulder height.
Side view. A person sitting on a flat bench, forearms resting on the thighs with palms facing up, wrists curled upward holding one dumbbell in each hand.
Front view. A person hanging from a straight horizontal pull-up bar with both arms fully straight, hands shoulder-width in an overhand grip, body and legs hanging straight down, feet off the floor.

Side view. A person standing upright facing a tall cable machine, elbows fixed at the sides, pushing a short straight bar down with both hands until the arms are straight, one cable running from the bar up to the high pulley.
Side view. A person lying on their back on a flat bench, upper arms vertical, elbows bent so that a short EZ curl bar held in both hands is lowered just above the forehead.
Side view. A person standing upright holding a single dumbbell with both hands behind the head, elbows bent and pointing up next to the ears.

Side view. A person standing upright, an elastic resistance band anchored above head height at the top of a door, elbows fixed at the sides, pushing the band down with both hands until the arms are straight.

Side view. A person at the bottom of a barbell back squat: the barbell with weight plates rests across the upper back and both hands grip the bar next to the shoulders, thighs parallel to the floor, back straight, feet flat.
Side view. A person in a deep squat holding one dumbbell vertically with both hands close in front of the chest, torso upright, feet flat on the floor.
Side view. A person sitting reclined in a 45 degree leg press machine, back against the pad, both feet on the angled foot plate, knees bent at about 90 degrees.
Side view. A person in a deep bodyweight squat with thighs parallel to the floor, arms stretched straight forward for balance, back straight, feet flat on the floor.
Side view. A person sitting in a leg extension machine, back against the pad, both legs extended straight forward with the padded roller resting on the lower shins.
Side view. A person sitting on a simple chair, an elastic resistance band running from the rear chair leg to one ankle, that leg extended straight forward against the band.
Side view. A person in a deep forward lunge: front knee bent at 90 degrees above the foot, rear knee just above the floor, torso upright, one dumbbell in each hand hanging at the sides.
Side view. A person in a deep forward lunge: front knee bent at 90 degrees above the foot, rear knee just above the floor, torso upright, hands on the hips.
Side view. A person standing in a standing calf raise machine, shoulders under the two shoulder pads, balls of the feet on a low step, raised high on the toes with heels lifted and legs straight.
Side view. A person standing upright raised high on the toes with heels lifted off the floor, legs straight, one dumbbell in each hand hanging at the sides.
Side view. A person standing with the balls of the feet on the edge of a low step, raised high on the toes with heels lifted, legs straight, one hand lightly touching a wall for balance.

Side view. A person at the start of a deadlift: the barbell with large weight plates is on the floor over the midfoot, the person is bent at hips and knees with a flat back, both arms straight down gripping the bar just outside the legs.
Side view. A person hinged forward at the hips with a flat back and only slightly bent knees, holding a barbell with weight plates with straight arms just below the knees, close to the shins.
Side view. A person hinged forward at the hips with a flat back and only slightly bent knees, holding one dumbbell in each hand with straight arms just below the knees, close to the shins.
Side view. A person standing upright with hips fully extended, both arms straight out in front holding one kettlebell with both hands at chest height.
Side view. A person standing with slightly bent knees, hips pushed back and the flat torso hinged forward to almost horizontal, arms crossed over the chest.
Side view. A person lying face down on a lying leg curl machine, hips on the pad, knees bent so that the padded roller behind the ankles is pulled up toward the buttocks.
Side view. A person lying on their back on the floor with hips lifted off the ground, knees bent, both heels resting on a small towel on the floor.

Side view. A person with the upper back resting on the edge of a flat bench, feet flat on the floor, knees bent at 90 degrees, hips pushed up so torso and thighs form one horizontal line, a barbell with weight plates resting across the hips held with both hands.

Side view. A person with the upper back resting on the edge of a flat bench, feet flat on the floor, knees bent at 90 degrees, hips pushed up so torso and thighs form one horizontal line, a single dumbbell resting on the hips held with both hands.
Side view. A person lying on their back on the floor, feet flat near the buttocks, hips pushed up so that knees, hips and shoulders form one straight line, arms resting on the floor at the sides.
Front view. A person sitting upright in a hip abduction machine, both legs pressed wide apart to the sides, a pad resting against the outside of each knee.
Front view. A person sitting upright in a hip adduction machine, both legs pressed together in the middle, a pad resting against the inside of each knee.

Side view. A person lying on their back on the floor, knees bent and feet flat, hands at the temples, head and shoulders curled up off the floor toward the knees while the lower back stays on the floor.
Side view. A person hanging from a horizontal pull-up bar with both arms straight, both knees pulled up toward the chest.

Side view. A person kneeling on the floor in front of a tall cable machine, holding a rope attachment with both hands beside the head, torso curled forward with a rounded back, one cable running from the rope up to the high pulley.
Side view. A person holding a forearm plank on the floor: forearms and toes on the ground, elbows under the shoulders, body in one straight line from head to heels.

Front view of a side plank. A person lying on one side, propped up on one forearm with the elbow under the shoulder, hips lifted so the body forms one straight diagonal line from head to feet, feet stacked, the free hand on the hip.

Side view. A person sitting on the floor, straight torso leaning back slightly, knees bent with heels on the floor, both hands clasped together in front of the chest and the upper body rotated to one side.

Front view. A person standing upright with feet shoulder-width apart next to a cable machine on their side, both arms extended straight forward at chest height holding one handle with both hands, one horizontal cable running sideways from the handle to the pulley.
Side view. A person running outdoors in an upright posture, mid-stride, one knee lifted forward, the opposite arm swinging forward, both elbows bent.
Side view. A person running in an upright posture on a treadmill with a console and handrails, mid-stride.
Side view. A person sitting on an upright stationary exercise bike, both hands on the handlebars, feet on the pedals, one leg almost extended downward.

Side view. A person sitting on the sliding seat of an indoor rowing machine at the finish of the stroke: legs extended, torso leaning back slightly, the handle pulled to the lower ribs with both hands, a chain running from the handle to the flywheel housing at the front.
Side view. A person standing upright on the pedals of an elliptical cross trainer, each hand holding one of the two moving handles, mid-stride.
Side view. A person walking upright with a short step, shoulders back, arms straight down at the sides, carrying one heavy dumbbell in each hand.
